title: CmdPal: More button is visible when there's not enough commands

judgment.rationale: An active upstream PR directly covers the reported More-button regression.
evidence: Issue discussion says More should only show for overflow beyond primary and secondary commands.
PR #49769 is open with matching title and scope.
CommandBar.xaml binds MoreCommandsButton visibility to ShouldShowContextMenu.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #49769 and do not start duplicate implementation work.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR #49769 is a concrete upstream fix attempt covering the reported behavior.

issue_context.summary: CmdPal shows More for an item with only primary and secondary commands even though those commands have dedicated buttons. The discussion confirms More should appear only for additional overflow, and PR #49769 directly targets this regression.
known_information: Issue is open, labeled Product-Command Palette, and assigned to jiripolasek.
The report reproduces the redundant More button.
The author states More should appear only when commands overflow.
PR #49769 is open and titled to hide the redundant More button.
inferences: The issue is covered by active upstream work rather than needing a competing design.
issue_context.analysis: The live cross-reference and PR scope match the symptom and intended behavior, so this artifact points to existing work.
initial_investigation: Inspected CommandBarViewModel and CommandBar.xaml visibility bindings.
Read PR #49769 summary and its regression-coverage claim.

existing_fixes.coverage: Hides the redundant More button and refactors command-bar menu availability with regression coverage.

comment.body: This report is covered by the active fix in #49769, which targets redundant Command Palette More-button visibility and includes regression coverage: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/49769
